name: Hugging Face
metaTitle: Hugging Face Model Fine-Tuning and Deployment
description: Techlio fine-tunes and deploys open-weights models and custom embedding pipelines inside private cloud environments for teams requiring full model ownership and data privacy.
h1: Open models, *running in your own cloud.*
answer: Hugging Face is the main hub for open-weights AI models and the libraries used to run and fine-tune them. Techlio uses it to deploy and adapt open models inside a client's own cloud, for teams that need full control over the model and where their data goes.

builds.title: Private model deployment
builds.text: Open language and embedding models served inside your cloud account, with autoscaling and monitoring.

builds.title: Fine-tuning
builds.text: Models adapted to your task and data, evaluated against a base model before anyone commits to them.

builds.title: Embedding pipelines
builds.text: Custom embeddings for search and retrieval over your documents.

fits: You want to own the model and avoid dependence on one provider
Volume is high enough that a smaller self-hosted model is cheaper

faqs.question: Are open models as good as commercial ones?
faqs.answer: For many focused tasks, yes. We test candidates against your eval set and show the difference in quality and cost.

faqs.question: What does self-hosting cost?
faqs.answer: Mainly GPU time and operations. We estimate it for your volume before recommending it.
